quote: The driver of a vehicle about to enter or exit a controlled-access highway shall yield the right-of-way to all vehicles approaching on the highway whose proximity constitutes an immediate hazard and shall continue to yield the right-of-way to that traffic until the driver may proceed with reasonable safety.

activation.condition: Driver is about to enter or exit a controlled-access highway; an approaching highway vehicle has proximity constituting an immediate hazard.

obligation.description: Yield right-of-way to all such approaching highway vehicles and continue to yield until the driver may proceed with reasonable safety.

timing.ordering: Continue yielding until reasonable safety permits proceeding; do not presume all traffic must pass first.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Public authority and permitted-access status require source review.
Proximity needs independent contextual judgment; projected gap is a diagnostic.
Continuing yield endpoint needs independent contextual judgment.

parameter_refs.name: engineering_yield_request_gap_s
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: 2.5 s or 5.0 s diagnostic yield request
